acceptanceCriteria: Line sits above the level number and fades with it, including the Reduce Motion crossfade
Timer starts at input unlock, stops at the goal move and excludes pauses
Value is display only: not persisted, sent or written to receipts
new.description: The between-levels banner shows Completion Time: MM:SS above the level number, fading with it. It uses the existing per-level run timer (start when input opens, stop at the goal, hold time excluded), is display only and never stored or sent.
new.title: Show the level clear time above the level number between levels

acceptanceCriteria: Only one fill is ever drawn inside a diamond
Fill grows inner to outer and drains outer to inner, with the Reduce Motion crossfade kept
All 8 diamonds show on the owner phone (needs phone model, mode and a bottom-edge screenshot)
new.description: The old instant half-size core on wrap-end diamonds is removed so the beam fill is the only interior colour. The fill grows from the inner tip and drains outer tip first. Owner reported two bottom diamonds missing in play: not reproduced headlessly, cause unconfirmed (hypothesis: rounded display corners clip the full-bleed corner kites).
new.title: Edge diamonds: one fill only, fill inner to outer, drain outer to inner

acceptanceCriteria: Star centroid within 0.5 device px of the painted interior centre on all tile shapes and DPRs
Owner confirms the centring on a phone
new.description: The goal star was centred by its bounding box and sat 1 to 2 device px low on every tile, up to 3.7 on corner tiles. It is now drawn on its circumcentre at the centre of the painted chip fill (bulb centre on dead ends).
new.title: Centre the goal star by its centre of mass in the tile
